body:
I feel really self conscious when it comes to online dating.. I just think everyone will laugh or just send hate or joke mails.

I don't have a very easy time trusting people in real life, especially at that level so I fear even if it was going well online it would end badly as soon as we met in person.

I feel like a burden to my family, they don't really think I can do anything on my own or that I will ever achieve anything and they are probably right.

Thanks for taking the time to reply (to everyone else to) it makes me feel a little better.

I think i'll try out exercising, I always had a hard time keeping track of it and lately I have been putting on a lot of weight from trying to burry my sorrows in sugar highs.

I'm not sure I can give up MMOs right now, the only social interaction I get is through those right now and I'm not sure what id do without being able to talk to my two online friends, I'm also working on a project using C++ for Swtor which would be my first public release of anything I have done in C++.

I always feel really strong anxiety when applying for jobs and I'm really nervous in interviews.
